name: Tsubaki
source: An elite assistant inspector belonging to the detective division. He's straightforward with a very strong sense of justice but is also very high-strung with a tendency to worry about the little things. He feels a deep rivalry with Tatewaki and often takes shots at the Side Kicks. He's interested in and concerned about Kurumi.
